scientific_notes: Original illustrative planar distribution transport diagram. Native editable reconstruction of the project-generated, user-approved apricot/sage contour artwork.

p0 and p1 denote schematic source and target distributions. Dots and nested support shapes are illustrative, not measured data, calibrated density or probability contours. The 23 dots in each region do not specify a sample-to-sample coupling.

Three smooth nonintersecting directed curves communicate transport from the source region toward the target. They are hand-defined illustration paths, not solutions of the older repository analytic flow or a learned differential equation.

The sparse background ripples are visual contour motifs only, with no scalar levels, potential, water dynamics or topographic measurements. Small arrows indicate schematic local direction; their lengths are not speeds.

Every contour, dot, path and label is a native slide object. No reference raster is embedded. The generated artwork is distributed separately for visual comparison; its subtle texture is intentionally not reproduced.
